nodes.name: p0003_submitStep1_author_during_step1
nodes.summary: The principal must be an author of the submission, and step 1 must be open for submissions.
nodes.source_excerpt: [source_id: src.cyberchair_access_control_intent.authorization_intent_covered.p0003.l9] Authors can submit abstracts/papers during step 1.

nodes.name: submitFullPaper_step2_author
nodes.summary: The principal must be listed as an author of the submission, must have step-2 credentials, and step 2 must currently be open.
nodes.source_excerpt: [source_id: src.cyberchair_access_control_intent.authorization_intent_covered.p0004.l10] 2. Authors with step-2 credentials can upload full papers during step 2.

nodes.name: author_during_step2
nodes.summary: The principal must be an author of the submission, and step 2 must be open for corrections.
nodes.source_excerpt: [source_id: src.cyberchair_access_control_intent.authorization_intent_covered.p0005.l11] Authors can correct step-1 submission information during step 2.

nodes.name: submitCameraReady_author_of_selected_after_review
nodes.summary: The principal must be an author of the submission, the submission must be marked as selected, and the review process must be complete.
nodes.source_excerpt: [source_id: src.cyberchair_access_control_intent.authorization_intent_covered.p0006.l12] Authors of selected submissions can submit camera-ready papers after review.

nodes.name: assigned_reviewer_post_distribution_not_conflicted
nodes.summary: The principal must be an assigned reviewer of the submission, paper distribution must be complete, and the principal must not have declared a conflict of interest.
nodes.source_excerpt: [source_id: src.cyberchair_access_control_intent.authorization_intent_covered.p0007.l13] "Assigned reviewers can access/download assigned papers after paper distribution, unless they have declared a conflict of interest."

nodes.name: submitReview_assigned_non_conflicted_reviewer
nodes.summary: The principal must be an assigned reviewer on the submission, not be in the conflicted reviewers set, and the review period must be open.
nodes.source_excerpt: [source_id: src.cyberchair_access_control_intent.authorization_intent_covered.p0008.l15] Assigned non-conflicted reviewers can submit or update reviews while review is open.

nodes.name: updateReview_assigned_non_conflicted_reviewer
nodes.summary: The principal must be an assigned reviewer on the submission, not be in the conflicted reviewers set, and the review period must be open.
nodes.source_excerpt: [source_id: src.cyberchair_access_control_intent.authorization_intent_covered.p0008.l15] Assigned non-conflicted reviewers can submit or update reviews while review is open.

nodes.name: reviewer_submitted_own_review
nodes.summary: The principal must have already submitted their own review for the submission.
nodes.source_excerpt: [source_id: src.cyberchair_access_control_intent.authorization_intent_covered.p0009.l16] Reviewers can read other reviewers' reviews for a paper only after submitting their own review for that paper.

nodes.name: assigned_reviewer_can_declare_conflict
nodes.summary: The principal is an assigned reviewer for the submission.
nodes.source_excerpt: [source_id: src.cyberchair_access_control_intent.authorization_intent_covered.p0010.l18] Reviewers can declare conflicts of interest for assigned papers.

nodes.name: reviewer_submitted_all_reviews_not_conflicted
nodes.summary: The principal must be a Reviewer who has submitted all assigned reviews and is not conflicted with the paper.
nodes.source_excerpt: [source_id: src.cyberchair_access_control_intent.authorization_intent_covered.p0011.l19] Reviewers may volunteer for papers with conflicting reviews only after they have submitted all assigned reviews and are not conflicted with the paper.

nodes.name: chair_pcc_role_check
nodes.summary: The principal's role must be 'Chair' or 'PCC' to monitor the review process.
nodes.source_excerpt: [source_id: src.cyberchair_access_control_intent.authorization_intent_covered.p0012.l21] 10. Chairs/PCC can monitor the review process and identify low-expertise papers.

nodes.name: PCC_asks_additional_reviewer_for_low_expertise_paper
nodes.summary: A Program Committee Chair (PCC) can request an additional reviewer for a paper that has only non-expert reviews.
nodes.source_excerpt: [source_id: src.cyberchair_access_control_intent.authorization_intent_covered.p0013.l22] 11. PCC can ask an additional reviewer to review a low-expertise paper.

nodes.name: reviewer_directory_allowed_users_access
nodes.summary: A user can access a reviewer directory if and only if they are on the directory's allowed-users list.
nodes.source_excerpt: [source_id: src.cyberchair_access_control_intent.authorization_intent_covered.p0014.l23] Reviewer directories and review files are protected from outsiders by per-directory allowed-user lists.

nodes.name: review_file_directory_protection
nodes.summary: A user can read a review file if and only if they are on the allowed-users list of the file's directory.
nodes.source_excerpt: [source_id: src.cyberchair_access_control_intent.authorization_intent_covered.p0014.l23] Reviewer directories and review files are protected from outsiders by per-directory allowed-user lists.
